summary: Frontend-only UI/UX regression test of the 5 redesigned Super Admin modules (Ratings & Reviews, Service Categories, Sub-Categories, Add-on Services, Custom Job Requests) using Playwright on the public preview URL. Logged in via 'Login as Admin' one-click button. All 5 tabs load without JS errors. All data-testids referenced in the review request are present. Confirmed NO native <input type=date> is used anywhere in these modules (0 native date inputs across all 5 tabs). Premium ConfirmDialog opens on category delete and can be cancelled. Edit button loads row into form (title changes to 'Edit Category'). Addons pagination navigates to page 2 showing 'Showing 11-20 of 33' correctly. Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) switches to dark mode and the Ratings page re-renders cleanly in dark theme (KPI cards, star filter pills, review card, pagination all legible). Ratings page displays KPIs: Total Reviews=1, Average Rating=5.0 (with stars), Services Reviewed=1, with a 'Reviews by Service' list and a 1-star--5-star filter bar, search box, and a 5-star review card. Custom Jobs renders the premium empty state 'No custom job requests found' with Search/Status/Category/Pincode/From-date/To-date filter bar, and the custom date popover opens on click (no native picker).
critical_code_review_comments: Pagination page-size select exposes only [10,20,50] options; the review request mentioned 'rows-per-page selector works' which it does, but if 25 is desired that option must be added to ModuleKit Pagination.
Ratings KPI labels are uppercased via CSS (e.g. 'TOTAL REVIEWS'); automated text-match selectors should rely on data-testids for KPI cards for more robust testability.
Toast/notification 'Turn on alerts' overlay appears over bottom-left on every tab load — not a bug, but confirm it does not obscure critical actions on smaller viewports.
seed_data_creation: None. Did NOT create/edit/delete persistent rows to avoid polluting shared seed data (categories delete was cancelled, addons status toggle was reverted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 redesigned admin modules verified. Data-testids verified: rv-search, rv-list, rv-filter-5, cat-search, cat-edit-*, cat-del-*, confirm-dialog/ok/cancel, chip-clear-all, pagination-controls/page-2/page-size, addon-search/edit-*, cja-search/empty/date-from/date-to, theme-toggle. No native date inputs anywhere. Dark mode works. Create flows were NOT executed to avoid seed pollution; main agent can self-verify create flows if required.
